sense: to make something go to someone

pins.definition: To make something go to a person or place, often by mail or electronic means.
To cause something or someone to go or be taken to a destination.
To cause mail, a parcel, or a message to go to a destination.

situation: A man drops a thick parcel into a postbox on a quiet street corner.
subject: the parcel in mid-motion
brief: A man in a blue coat has just released a heavy brown parcel into the open slot of a red roadside postbox, the box casting a sharp geometric shadow on the pavement. The parcel is tilted vertically, caught halfway through the mouth of the slot as it begins its descent into the dark interior.
prompt: A man in a blue coat has just released a heavy brown parcel into the open slot of a red roadside postbox, the box casting a sharp geometric shadow on the pavement. The parcel is tilted vertically, caught halfway through the mouth of the slot as it begins its descent into the dark interior. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
